rules: Dev = `docker compose up --watch` from the root, served on :8088.
It is a website: native scroll only.
Scenes carry short lines; long text goes in `details`.
The website is audience material for a talk.
Before building anything by hand, check for an established skill/plugin that does it (and say which you used).

docs.purpose: routes, folders, data flow, API, tables, migrations
palette, knobs, glass, motion and transition types, component sources
topics/scenes model, assessment questions, experiment templates, audit rules, copy limits
Docker/watch behaviour, lint, backups, known Compose quirks
where it's heading next and which outside libraries to use
questions for the owner and known gaps (read at session start; add, don't ask in the site)
append-only log of decisions and rejected options. Look things up; don't load it whole.

decisions.text: Stack: React 19 + TanStack Router/Query + Tailwind 4 + Vite; FastAPI on Granian; Postgres 18; Alembic.
decisions.owner: asked for this in the original spec.
decisions.rejected: plain uvicorn — user asked for something current.

decisions.text: No `useEffect` family; enforced by ESLint `no-restricted-imports`.
decisions.owner: asked for this in the original spec.
decisions.why: forces loaders, Query, external stores, ref callbacks.

decisions.text: No lockfiles, no host installs; versions pinned exactly in `package.json` / `requirements.txt`.
decisions.owner: asked for this in the original spec.
decisions.why: Trade-off: transitive deps can drift between builds.

decisions.text: TypeScript pinned to 6.0.3.
nginx is the edge in both dev and prod on :8088; prod nginx image contains the built SPA.
decisions.owner: asked for the frontend build to ship beside the backend; nginx gives rate limits + CSP in one place.

decisions.text: Rate limiting lives in nginx, not the app.
decisions.why: Multiple Granian workers would each keep their own counters.

decisions.text: Vite assets are never inlined (`assetsInlineLimit: 0`).
decisions.why: Inlined fonts became `data:` URIs that the CSP blocked.

decisions.text: Real refraction glass via SVG displacement maps, Chromium only, frosted fallback elsewhere.
decisions.owner: wanted bending glass, not frosted.
decisions.rejected: CSS-only blur glass as the primary effect.

decisions.text: Branding is "AI Workflow Habits" / "Workflow Habits".
One theme: graphite + one blue accent + warn for risk only. Per-section tone system deleted.
decisions.rejected: per-section rainbow palette — user called the colours poor.

decisions.text: Radii 20/12/16; top bar no longer a full pill.
decisions.owner: bar edges too round.

decisions.text: Dev is the default compose profile: `docker compose up --watch` is the whole command.
decisions.rejected: Makefile-only entry and a `dev` profile — the plain command started only Postgres.

decisions.text: Dev images use `pull_policy: build`.
decisions.why: Watch only syncs changes after start; containers ran stale code.

decisions.text: `make lint` mounts host source into throwaway containers.
decisions.why: `exec` linted a stale container copy and passed.

decisions.text: Content split into short scenes with three depths of detail (scene → line `more` → Details & sources).
decisions.owner: walls of text won't be read; info on demand.

decisions.text: Tried a full-screen slideshow (keyboard + wheel navigation, builds, overview).
Website with screen-height scenes, native scroll, `scroll-snap-type: y proximity`, per-kind reveal transitions.
Reveal triggers sit on the unclipped `<article>`; the clipped child animates.
decisions.why: A fully clipped element never intersects, so iris/wipe scenes stayed invisible.

decisions.text: Information system in the repo: `CLAUDE.md` (core) + `docs/Apply the brief's own findings to the codebase.*
decisions.why: ` (reference) + this log + a skill + a content check.
decisions.rejected: Notion/Obsidian connectors — plain files are enough.

decisions.text: Libraries: keep Motion; adopt Bklit charts selectively; port Kokonut ideas; reject anime.js. See `docs/target.md`.
The site is a toolkit, not a stat show: setup audit, self-assessment, experiment log, knowledge base.
decisions.owner: "glorified stat show"; asked for real self-dissection and picked all four functions.

decisions.text: Light theme only, chosen by contrast math: off-white canvas, near-black ink, Okabe-Ito blue accent, dark vermilion for risk, Okabe orange as second data series.
decisions.rejected: dark theme — user; research favours dark text on light for reading/projecting.

decisions.text: Information architecture: landing hub → one page per topic → tools.
Transition types: route changes use View Transitions with types (topic-next/prev, enter-topic, page); sub-scenes use scroll-linked Motion envelopes, entry-only.
decisions.owner: asked for different transitions for topics vs sub-slides.

decisions.text: Content de-coupled from presenting: talk material moved to optional `presenting` topic.
decisions.owner: presentation is undecided.

decisions.text: Notes became knowledge-base entries (kinds: finding/source/question/note); data migrated, `notes` dropped.
Audit analysis runs client-side and is stored as-is. Score = 100·e^(−penalty/75) so messy setups don't floor at 0.
Range knob and toggle redesigned (white knob, hairline, shadow, accent halo). Removed the "drag the lens" label.
decisions.owner: knobs looked ugly.

decisions.text: `backend/alembic/` renamed `backend/migrations/` (the folder shadowed the library name).
The site is audience material for the talk, not a channel to the owner. Presenter-only topic removed (demo plan + framing → `docs/talk-notes.md`); questions and gaps live in `docs/open-questions.md`.
decisions.owner: "Stop treating the website itself as a medium to communicate with me."

decisions.text: Check established skills/plugins before hand-building. Suggested: frontend-design, Design, code-review, Data.
decisions.owner: the first question should have been why we weren't using skills that many people use.

decisions.text: Installed 12 community skills into the repo via `npx skills add` (run in a node container): frontend-design, web-design-guidelines, vercel-react-best-practices, design-taste-frontend, emil-design-eng, review-animations, improve-animations, tailwind-design-system, webapp-testing, grill-me, improve-codebase-architecture, skill-creator. Removed the CLI's duplicate `agent/skills/` copies (variants for another agent).
decisions.owner: "Run them all."

decisions.text: From the two pasted generator specs: (a) exhibit + (b) port the scrub idea. No third-party (Higgsfield/CloudFront) assets. Hero is now the context scrubber: one 200k window, bloated vs tiered, comparison-slider pattern (clip-path inset, hover/drag/keys, ±4% centre dead zone, one sweep on first view). Lens, flow paths, hero eyebrow, gradient accent word and the widget "Interactive" eyebrow removed. Exhibit added to the mistakes topic. Skills used: frontend-design, emil-design-eng, design-taste-frontend.
decisions.owner: "Build what you can, don't use those higgsfield assets."

decisions.text: Versioning: git initialised by the owner (first commit "Init"); `.env`, backups and node_modules are not tracked.
Higgsfield: not installing now. Also parked: Paper Shaders, react-three-fiber.
decisions.owner: "I don't think I need cool 3D assets to get my point through."

decisions.text: Direction under review: de-prestige the talk toward zero-setup habits for busy lab members (see open-questions #0).

Added evidence on screen: what "residue" is (evidence), Index Sickness stat + "methods section vs lab notebook" (memory), SkillReducer stat + "rubrics, not prompts" (skills), learning-RCT stat with scope caveat (human cost). Trifecta reframed: it needs an assistant that can act; uploading anonymised data is a privacy/IRB question, not this one.
decisions.owner: habits lacked premise and mechanism; stats must be on the slides; inferences must be worded as inferences.

decisions.text: Stat scenes now require `study` (what the researchers did, plain language) and `meaning` (what it means for the reader); `make check-content` enforces both. Jargon removed from scenes (IFScale, ACE, "false completed state", "lossy compression", "boundary condition"). Talk abstract + yes-man test kit drafted in `docs/talk-notes.md`.
decisions.owner: "pushing out stats without clearly explaining what they're for will frustrate people."

decisions.text: Truncation/compaction evidence added to Evidence: "Hitting the limit doesn't clean the chat" (Liu et al., Lost in the Middle) and the compaction stat (Wang et al. 2026, preprint). Product truncation behaviour is labelled "reported" (third-party guides only). Sources render as preview cards from publisher og:images fetched once by `make previews` (rejected: hot-linking — CSP and link rot; screenshots — heavier, more copyright exposure). Skills audit: `vercel-react-best-practices` → lazy routes (index 666→305 KB), unused italic font dropped; `web-design-guidelines` → skip link, confirm on deletes, live regions, reduced motion via `MotionConfig`, text-wrap balance/pretty, touch-action; `tailwind-design-system` → radius tokens + one `field` utility (inputs were 10px, now 12px). `improve-animations` findings recorded in open-questions, not yet planned.

Every widget scene carries a guide (what you're looking at · try · the point) and a data badge (study, estimate, your input, diagram, our judgement, from this repository); `make check-content` enforces it. Feeling-vs-stopwatch rebuilt: the measured dot is fixed by design and now says so, "they felt" marker added, what-if line, link to a new `speed-check` experiment (`/experiments?template=`); the learning-quiz chart split into its own widget.
decisions.owner: the diagrams felt decorative; "shows 19% regardless of how fast the user feels."

decisions.text: "9 → 0" re-checked against the paper: corrections matching Index Sickness, 9 of 45 (sessions 136–214) vs 0 of 20 (253–395); the −56% cut was spec documents, not the rules file. Copy fixed.
decisions.owner: "What's 9 → 0 though?"

decisions.text: Topic 11 "How this site was built": the AI's files and the code layers, the decision log, honest tool status, what was built on a whim. Numbers come from the repo via `make facts` (`scripts/build-facts.ts` → `content/build-facts.json`). Home topic grid replaced by a site map (5 groups × topics × scene classes × tools); every topic opens with an outline. Yes-man run 1 added to memory.
decisions.owner: present how the app was built; navigate with meta-diagrams; be honest that the tools have no users and some parts were whims.

skills.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

checks.name: make lint
checks.what: ESLint + tsc (frontend) and Ruff (backend) on your current files, inside containers

checks.name: make check-content
checks.what: Enforce copy limits on the brief (docs/content.md)

checks.name: make facts
checks.what: Re-read CLAUDE.md, docs/, the decision log and skills → content/build-facts.json (topic 11)

checks.name: make previews
checks.what: Fetch link-preview images for every cited source → frontend/public/previews + content/previews.json
